entities.summary: Colin Campbell Sanborn (1897–1962) was a US ecologist and biologist, employed as curator of birds and mammals at the Field Museum of Natural History in Chicago. His works include taxonomic revisions of the Chiroptera bat families, and he was recognised in the specific epithet of the broad-nosed bat Scotorepens sanborni.
